devdoc.details: Credentials are linked to a holder's DID and issued by trusted      issuers. Only credential hashes are stored on-chain — raw data      stays off-chain for privacy. Privacy: Only dataHash is stored on-chain. The verifier checks the hash matches but never sees the raw credential data.

params._dataHash: keccak256 hash of the credential data
